capabilities: generate a Seedance video into the current note from a prompt and aspect ratio
animate a vault image (PNG, JPEG, WebP) as the first frame of a clip
generate a still image into the current note
configure video model, clip length and resolution in settings
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; every generation run costs credits on the emaki account; Japanese-language usage docs are linked separately (シーダンス).
problem: Generating AI video normally means leaving the vault for a website and manually downloading and embedding the result.

relations.evidence: Official plugin for emaki (emaki.ai), the Japanese-language AI video generator

summary: emaki.ai client that generates Seedance 2.5 video clips or still images into notes and animates vault images, using an emaki API key.
